children: New Delhi, Nov. 7 -- The Diwali 2026 Muhurat trading session is few hours away, with investors preparing for the auspicious special live trading session on NSE and BSE on Sunday, November 8. For investors who prioritise regular dividend income, alongside potential capital appreciation, here's a curated list of six dividend-paying stocks featured in brokerages' Diwali stock picks, offering attractive dividend yield.

HCL Tech has announced a dividend of Rs.60 over the last twelve months. With this, its annual dividend yield stood at 3.96%. Its share price value closed at Rs.1438.60 per share on BSE on Friday, November 6.

BPCL has announced a total of Rs.10 per equity share dividend over the last one year. Its annual dividend yield stood at 2.72%. Its share price value closed 0.63% higher at Rs.319 per share on BSE on Friday.

Canara Bank's share price ended unchanged at Rs.122.80 per share on BSE on Friday. The financial lender has rewarded investors with Rs.4.20 per share dividend over the last one year. Its annual dividend yield stood at 3.02%.
The stock closed 0.45% higher at Rs.5530 per share on BSE on Friday. The company has paid Rs.187 per share dividend over the last 12 months. Its dividend yield stood at 3.47%.
(Note: Dividend yields have been calculated based on the stocks' market prices as of one year ago.)
